entities.name: Methyl isoxazole carboxylate
observations: Reactant is methyl 5-(2-hydroxyphenyl)isoxazole-3-carboxylate, containing a methyl ester.
The ester is converted to the corresponding carboxylic acid while the aryl/isoxazole framework remains unchanged.

entities.name: Isoxazole carboxylic acid
observations: Product is the corresponding 5-(2-hydroxyphenyl)isoxazole-3-carboxylic acid formed by ester hydrolysis.

entities.name: Ester saponification
observations: The reaction replaces the methyl ester methoxy group with hydroxyl to form a carboxylic acid.
The exact database precedent uses lithium hydroxide; acidic workup is chemically implied but not explicitly listed.
NaOH or KOH are mechanistic analogues, typically followed by acidification.

entities.name: LiOH hydrolysis conditions
observations: Lithium hydroxide is the directly supported reagent for hydrolyzing this methyl ester; aqueous or mixed aqueous-organic solvent and subsequent acidification are consistent with the transformation.
